text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Trainer.
Do you know what concept art is?

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
It's concept art to share the world setting~...
They're often made right at the start
in movies and manga productions!

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Well, my story is already in progress...
It's not like this is the 'beginning.'

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
But—
I thought maybe I could start over from here!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"And so, Kiseki
pressed the brush against the canvas."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Scooping colors from the palette, layering them upon the canvas.
All to create a color uniquely hers.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The sun went down, and their white breaths stood out
in the cold. But Kiseki didn't leave that spot.

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
...Trainer, you know you're free
to head back first, right?
choice_data_list: Still, I'm really curious to see the finished painting.

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text: Haaah...!

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
You're so unfair, you know that?!
I feel like I'll never stand a chance against you!

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text: In other words, does that mean "you want to see my art"?

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Understood!
Let's go one more time!

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Yes! With that cheer,
I feel like I could move at 10 times my normal speed!

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Don't hold back!
It only fires me up more,
which means nothing but good things will happen!

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text: Go right ahead, then!

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Sounds good!
Keep it coming, please!

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Not yet!
Just as I feel it!
choice_data_list: I want to see a masterpiece.

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Ahaha, is that all?
You just want to look?
choice_data_list: I want to have fun with your drawings!!
I want to have fun with your drawings!!

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
...! Ahahaha!
I like it, you're quite the greedy one yourself!

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Then again, you can't create anything at all
without a little ambition, right?!

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text: Now, for the finishing touches!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And Kiseki adds the final touch of color
to the canvas. In that painting—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Endlessly, on and on.
It depicted the two of us running
toward a boundless horizon.

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text: I'll be sure to give you a present.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
While displaying Kiseki's drawing,
she muttered something in the Trainer's Room.

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Everything you wished for while drawing this picture...
I swear I will deliver it all straight to you.

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text: That makes the next time even more exciting, right? Like, 'What's she gonna give me next?!'

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text: Please, dream an endless dream through me.

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
"In this genre, I can give you something
even better than Santa on Christmas."

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text: Please keep expecting great things from me, always.

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Countless races and unseen turfs
are still waiting for us.

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text: —Let us run.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Invited by Kiseki, who had just finished her painting,
we look up at the sky from the observation deck.
choice_data_list: It feels like you could leap right past the stars.
It feels like you could leap right over the stars themselves.

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Fufufu,
you even ended up painting a galaxy with that picture, after all.

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text: Why don't we make that happen right now while we're at it?
choice_data_list: Ahaha, that'd be amazing if you could do it.
Ahaha, that'd be amazing if you could do it!

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
"Enjoy laughing while you still can.
...Now then, crouch down!"

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text: Exactly! ...Hup!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Suddenly, my vision went dark.
From the sliver of sight left, I realized
she had covered my eyes with her hands.

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
"Oh, am I allowed to speak?
Isn't this outer space?"

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Yes, whoooosh~!
Trainer and I have made a safe landing on that star!

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
And now, I'm returning to Earth!
Boarding the rocket... rumble rumble rumble...
Whooooosh...!

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text: All right, that's the end of our space journey!
choice_data_list: Oh, that was surprisingly short a journey.
I see, I see. That was a surprisingly short journey.

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text: Ahaha. And so, that's the story.

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text: Those are the souvenirs brought back from the stars.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I follow Kiseki's gaze,
only to find an unfamiliar tie clip pinned to my chest.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I follow Kiseki's gaze,
only to see an unfamiliar necklace shining around my neck.

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Ahaha,
wouldn't it be fun to try coming at it
from this angle once in a while?

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text: ...Did that make your heart race?

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Ah, no giving it back!
It's a present, so please accept it.

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text: ...Merry Christmas!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Seeing her smug grin,
I couldn't help but hold my head in my hands.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
You really never know what Kiseki is going to pull next...
She's an Umamusume who constantly does shocking things.
